description:
Goal
Make the pull artifact path measurable enough that zero means zero. The current PullSession root_scans/follow_ups counters are emitted but never incremented, so they do not prove absence of pass-shaped work or producer pokes.

Signal
For fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz no-dump interp, telemetry distinguishes public compiler jobs from product-internal forbidden work. Tests fail if the product path calls root_executable_frontier, consumes root TransportPlan as a dependency, scans fact tables for executable inclusion, or asks a consumer to schedule a producer. Product session counters are backed by increment sites and stay zero only when no such work occurred.

Strategy
Add narrow instrumentation at the dangerous APIs and product driver boundaries before changing behavior: root executable frontier/fact-table scans, product fact producer pokes, legacy root transport/semantic dependency reads, and any product helper that expands a collection to discover work. Keep measurement names precise enough to tell local component iteration from root/global discovery.

Removal target
Delete or replace the current write-never PullSession counters. No new permanent scaffolding without a cleanup ticket.

Verification
cargo test -q --lib compiler2_pull_; focused telemetry test for 00181 asserting honest zero counters; post-process --log-telemetry no-dump interp and report job counts plus product forbidden-work counters.
title: Pull path: make forbidden-work telemetry honest
